name: io.github.ACTA-Team/docs-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for the official ACTA verifiable credentials documentation.

environmentVariables.name: ACTA_DOCS_MCP_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip the remote docs fetch and use only the documentation bundled in the package.

environmentVariables.name: ACTA_DOCS_MCP_DATA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the remote documentation JSON URL. Only use a source you fully trust.
